# Document templates

Put an `ADR.md`, `RFC.md` or `PRD.md` here to override the template the
authoring tools use. They check this directory first.

This directory holds no templates, on purpose. A copy of a default template
changes nothing and pins that template at the version you copied, so later
improvements to it never reach this repository. Add one only when eidos needs
a section the default does not have, and write in the file what that section
is for.
